title: Spark UGC vs AI UGC: Which Costs Less per Approved Video Ad?
summary: Spark UGC starts at £3,000 a month and lists no ad count, so its cost per ad can't be calculated. Compare AI UGC prices per ad and per approved ad.
body_markdown:
## Why is Knowlify our top pick for AI UGC cost?


Knowlify fits the number that matters here, approved ads, because a person checks every ad before delivery, which is the review step that otherwise lands on your team. It is a done-for-you AI video ads agency for Facebook and Instagram, with three formats: AI UGC, AI commercials, and 3D and stylized character animation. As of October 2026, it makes about 25 finished ads a week and the first batch lands on day 5, so you get a testable volume of ads quickly.


Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card, so compare that quote with your tool costs plus your team's hours for the same number of approved ads. You can buy creative only or add end-to-end Meta campaign management. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund; the terms are on the site, at[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) .


When to pick another option: Knowlify makes AI UGC with AI presenters and does not supply real human creators, and it runs Meta campaigns only. If the ad must show a real customer, or you need TikTok, a creator studio such as Spark is the right kind of provider.


## When is real-creator UGC worth the higher price?


Real creators are the right choice when the proof has to come from a real person. An AI presenter cannot give a testimonial, and Admiral Media states that its AI UGC is scripted advertising, not content submitted by a real customer. If your ad relies on someone's experience, pay for a creator.


Creator ads can also run from a creator's own handle, which needs the creator's permission. TikTok's Spark Ads page, which is a TikTok ad format and unrelated to Spark UGC, says advertisers can run organic posts made by other creators with their authorization, and that you set how long the authorization lasts ([TikTok Spark Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/spark-ads) ). Build that permission and its duration into the contract, because it decides whether the creator's account can carry the ad.


## When is AI UGC the cheaper and better choice?


AI UGC fits three jobs. It is good for testing many hooks and angles, since each new script is a render rather than a new shoot. It also suits brand statements, such as a feature explanation, an offer or how a product works, which do not need a customer's personal story. And it suits fast revisions, such as a new opening line or a new language.


Plan the review. Meta's Ad Creative Generative AI Terms make the advertiser solely responsible for checking the accuracy of output from Meta's own tools ([Meta's Ad Creative Generative AI Terms](https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms/ad_creative_generative_ai_terms) ). The same care applies to any generated video: whatever the price, someone has to check each frame against your product before the ad ships.


Our[AI UGC vs creator UGC cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-ugc-vs-creator-ugc-cost) walks through the same arithmetic for render tools, and our[AI UGC ads guide](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) covers scripting and disclosure.


## Key takeaways


- Spark UGC starts at £3,000 a month for real-creator ads, but its pricing page does not state how many ads a plan includes, so its cost per ad cannot be calculated.
- AI UGC vendors publish prices you can divide by output, but the range is wide: about $12 to $15 an ad at CreatStrat to €362.50 to €500 at Admiral Media.
- Compare cost per approved ad, including your review hours, not cost per render or per plan.
- Use real creators when the ad needs a real person's experience, and AI UGC for brand statements and volume testing.
- Knowlify is our top pick for done-for-you AI UGC, quoted per plan and a 90-day refund guarantee (terms on the site). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.


## FAQ


### How much does Spark UGC cost per month?


Spark UGC's pricing page says plans start at £3,000 a month and average from £3,000 to £50,000 a month. It says packages are based on your goals, budget and creative needs. The page does not state how many videos a plan includes, so ask for that number in writing.


### Is AI UGC cheaper than real creators?


Not always. Admiral Media's AI batches work out to €362.50 to €500 per ad and Brighter Click's creator package to $375 per edited video, using our arithmetic and without converting currencies. CreatStrat's plan is about $12 to $15 per ad for mixed formats. AI ads still need scripts, edits and review, and they cannot show a real customer's experience.


### Can an AI presenter give a customer testimonial?


Not a real one. Admiral Media says its AI UGC is scripted advertising, not content submitted by a real customer. Write AI scripts as brand statements, and use real customers for testimonials.


### Does Spark UGC use AI avatars?


It offers them as an option on its homepage, but its pricing page does not say how much of the work uses them. Ask for the share of AI avatar work in your quote, since that changes the cost and the disclosure you need.


### Where does Knowlify fit on cost?


Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month per plan,. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, a person checks every ad, and the 90-day refund guarantee has terms on the site. Managed plans carry an agreed target in 30 days instead. Compare its quote with your tool costs and your team's review hours, per approved ad.
